display_long_description:
Boxten VR Boxing — throw real punches, take real hits

Raise your fists and fight with your whole body. No button combos — just you, your reach, and an opponent who reads every opening you leave.

NEW: ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Fight real players online in head-to-head 1v1 matches. Read their rhythm, punish their mistakes, and prove who owns the ring.

15 FIGHTERS, 15 FIGHTING STYLES
From cyber ninjas to flame-wielding champions, every opponent brings a different rhythm, reach, and set of combos.
[media]

5 VR ARENAS
Trade blows on neon city rooftops and inside ancient battle temples.
[media]

5 DIFFICULTY LEVELS
Easy to Extreme. As you climb, opponents react faster, block smarter, and unlock new attacks.
[media]

REAL MELEE COMBAT
Duck a hook. Slip a jab. Counter while they recover. Your movement is your defense.

A REAL WORKOUT
Bob, weave, and swing your way to a full-body workout that never feels like exercise.

BUILT FOR META QUEST
Play solo vs AI or online vs real opponents. Compatible with Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest 3S, and Quest Pro.

Step in. Lock eyes. Raise your fists.
